I would definitely recommend staying there. Prices are reasonable too.  Oh, also I left a couple things the first time like my charger for my phone and my favorite soap and gloves. name: WV Almost Heaven
text: Our server Allison made the the whole experience WONDERFUL. She was so congenial and happy. It is for her we give the 3rd star. Sometimes when a server comes by to ask "How is everything, is everything okay" it is a necessary function. Not with Allison. As for the food it was 2 stars. Not great, not bad, just meh. The ambiance & overall atmosphere was very busy & not pleasing. The music was WAY to loud and in direct competition with the 2 football games playing and the one basketball game. There were more than few overly inebriated (patrons that were loud and off putting.) This is NOT a family atmosphere establishment, regardless how they bill themselves. While some of the drunks were overtly and obliviously loud several more were bousterous and argumentative. If not for Allison the evening would have been a negative. Allison apologized more than once & told us that it was the managers prerogative to remove unpleasant patrons. Unless we could fbe sure that Allison would be there, we do not plan to go back. Overall the evening was a 2 star evening, but Allison made it bearable and gets the 3rd star all to her self.

name: Daniel Kleeh
text:
A couple years ago I would have rated this location as a 4 or 5 star experience; however, over the years this location has become lax with their service and food quality is nowhere near where it used to be.

Portions have become smaller, wings may or may not come with sauce on the entire order, and wait staff may disappear for extended periods of time, and the last two services I had at this location it took an hour or more (seriously not joking) for our group to receive our food order.

I'm giving this location a 3-star rating and feeling that I may be being generous after my most recent experience.

name: Jessica Campbell

Normally, I have no complaints, great food and wonderful staff.
Today, my family meet at Perkins, we get a waitress who I have never seen here before, I order strawberry crepes and am I surprised the strawberries and the strawberry sauce straight out of the refrigerator had made my crepe become just as cold. I told the waitress about how cold my crates are and she explains to me that the strawberries are not supposed to be heated up before being placed on the crepes, WHAT??!!
Hailey (the waitress/seever) told me that the strawberries are stored cold ( of course, alright...) then tells me that there supposed to be cold on the crepes and continues to repeat herself.

I won't be sitting in her section again and we paid $7.50 for TINY tiny cold crepes.

While we were there a discruntal employee came in and  had some very loud words with the manager of the evening,  the police were called and  they did a walk through to calm any worries patrons may have had about the episode.  It was very obvious that they were short staffed but the employees on staff were doing everything they could to make up for it. They were extremely apologetic.  The food was good.  I believe if the owners would work out their low staff issues and commend the staff they have,  this would be a fantastic place to dine.

name: Jim Lee
text: In a word, we had a great first experience. Bea our waitress/owner was delightful. My wife and I travel for work and know our Thai food. Surin is among the top 4 in our travels from CA, to New Englang and many points in between. If you have never experienced Thai, you must. So many different flavors! Don't  ever worry about a dish being too spicy. Most places have a simple 1 through 5 chilies. 5 being hottest. Ask Bea and she will make it right. We loved both of our dishes which had generous amounts of seafood in one, and duck in the other. Also, you have to try the chicken Satay. It is a marinated skewer of chicken with a peanut dipping sauce that perhaps was the best we have ever had. Surin also has a good beer and wine selection.

name: Dalene Hepburn
text: Really enjoyed our meal. It was very authentic Thai food. I have been lucky to eat Thai food in a lot of different places L.A. to Boston and this was such a pleasure to find in Huntington. The owner Bia waited on us. She was personable and attentive. The food was delicious and the plating was a beautiful presentation. Bia let us know she grows a lot of the herbs and peppers they use right in her own yard. I love that! The atmosphere is well appointed and very clean. We will be going back.

I have a knee injury and after placing an order and parking out front they was unable to bring my order to me. I told them I am paying cash and tip on the order. Jordan said we cannot being it out due to liability issues. I have had an order brought out before in the past no issue at all. I have only had to do this twice due to my knee issue. I said I need to cancel the order then. He said sure no problem as if it's no big deal. Most businesses will bring an order out curb side if needed. The food is not cheap and I always tip on top of my order.  I wonder if catering is a liabilty issue too? I'm sure hosptials and lawyers offices need help with orders being brought to their vehicle out front regardless of what I was told. As a family owned restaurant this is not the hospitality I expected.

Thanks for your feedback! Unfortunately, while we would love to help accommodate your mobility/parking issue - at this time we do not provide curb side pick up.  I apologize that this policy resulted in you cancelling your order - but we must keep our staff’s safety as a top priority, and thus cannot deliver food off property to customer vehicles.

name: Chad Silva
text: I took the Waterfall Combo expedition - a five hour adventure into some of the deepest parts of the cave. It was a great experience, and I would absolutely come back to see other parts of the cave. I found it physically challenging, despite being in quite good shape. Good footwear is essential, but be prepared to get dirty/muddy. A small, tight fitting backpack for water and snacks is a good idea, but little else was necessary (I had a light jacket, but took it off half way and just wore a t-shirt).

name: Kati Holland
text: The cave itself is very neat and spans 70+ miles total (only 34 miles have been passed through). Lots of history, very cool, open passageways for a quick 1-1.5 hour tour that's only 2.2 miles. Just beware, this is privately owned entrance (the only commercial entrance)  and instead of answering scientific questions with actual facts, the guides simply say the fossils are because of Noah's ark and the flood. I knew this going in from other reviews and even saw the poster on the gift shop wall proudly proclaiming this belief. I actually am a spiritual person, however, I am a believer in science and much prefer a different kind of tour;) With all that said, it's still a cool cave so I'm giving it 4. I'd 3.5 were an option, though, it would be that.

name: ko2bme101
text: Well, I just arrived with our party of 3 reservation by the window, for my birthday dinner. We are cramped in a corner with a couple next to us. My mother had walked up to the front and requested that we be moved to two tables to the right next to the window and was informed that we are not allowed to because the server will not be returning for 45 minutes. I will show the photographs of the difference in the space of the tables where our current server, could have easily accommodated us to have privacy if she was given permission to. We've come here several times and my parents in fact actually end up paying for other people's meals in kind as random acts of kindness (as they are usually younger). This will be our last time at F&F and happy birthday to me : ) ETA the food was subpar. The Shrooms were decedent with a non greasy body with the most perfect, moist, tender mushrooms inside. The salad was less than a handful, the crab cakes and few vegetables were edible yet nothing great. Over the past several years the food and service has gone down hill to the point the amazing delicious homemade bread pot is not reason to go out to what is considered a "fine dining establishment/experience." My 12 year old son even made a comment regarding the service being so slow even considering this is not a 5 star restaurant. We waited over 1.25 hours for our main course (possibly 5 tables in the entire restaurant were seated for service. There was an attendant whom we saw more than our server. Empty plates, glasses and garnish/dressing dishes weren't removed. When the server left the bill tableside there was a rush of urgency directed towards my mother looking in her handbag for payment. I politely told her to come back to our table for payment. At checkout, the same lady (hostess) who told my mother we were not allowed to switch tables, "B" couple doesn't mind we are "ontop of them" then went on to ask how our meal was. I'm glad I was not asking to be moved because I do not pay mind if "B" couple doesn't mind us so close, I do and I'm the patron! My mother recounted how the experience started and reasons above stated. I came up and the lady started berating my mother with a condescending attitude and sarcastic comments about how busy they were. I stepped in and shared the amount of customers when we were all seated for out dining experience and that what she was saying to my mother is a lie. She proceeded to continue to be rude and it was made known to her that constructive criticism from a customer would be appreciated in such an establishment and I've read the reviews on many social media outlets as well as our own experience leading up to this afternoon's birthday dinner and suggested they read them. There seems to be several common denominators listed by patrons. Save your money and go to another quaint restaurant in the area where customers are appreciated. To be fair this is not a one time occurrence, yet as stated the past couple of years there's been a decline in food quality, taste, rudeness and lack of service you'd expect from a restaurant of this relatively not inexpensive restaurant. The Asylum in Downtown Lewisburg has amazing food and a more relaxed atmosphere late afternoon if you choose that environment for your dinner meal. Also,  if you want a fine and comfortable quaint dining experience pay the same and go to the Greenbrier Resort Forum Restaurant and enjoy your special meal, impeccable service and delicious food! Happy birthday to me : )

I'm not against being vegetarian, we took our vegetarian friends there and they loved it.  Personally I don't like meat very much. But I do like me a good Grilled cheese sandwich with a cold Coke Zero and maybe some baked fries. Just saying if you're not totally vegetarian you may want to go someplace else.

resp.text:
Sorry our menu did not suit you.  We have never made pretenses of being anything other than vegetarian.  The bread you are referring to is an Artisan bakery bread called Ciabatta bread.  Coke is very unhealthy with high fructose corn syrup in it and we choose not to support them.
Again my apologies that we were not the type of place you enjoy but there are many other places in town that serve sandwiches with meat on white bread and have Coca Cola products

name: Kevin
text:
The Wild Bean is a unique, local coffee and tea hub with a delightful hipster vibe. Inside, they offer a wide selection of not only coffee and tea, but also vinyl records, fresh coffee beans, CDs featuring local music groups, and a cute array of coffee accessories. Favor a tasteful game of chess with a partner while sipping on a hot cup of coffee? The Wild Bean provides free boardgames that can be easily played on any of their tables.

While I'm not the biggest coffee drinker, I feel I have the palette to decipher between a mediocre and excellent cup of coffee, and I can say with the utmost confidence that the average coffee drinks they offer are certainly above average. For example, there's no comparison of a paper cup of Starbucks coffee to a beautifully presented, ceramic cup of joe that the Wild Bean serves.

Unfortunately, there are some downsides. They do have a food menu, consisting completely of vegetarian fare. While tasty, the portions are small, expensive, and ordinary(You'd be better off traveling down the sidewalk to the infamous Food and Friends.) Also, their specialty drinks(mainly chilled) are not special at all. They're overly sweet, poorly blended slushes served with a pile of whipped cream on the top. If I craved such a drink, I *would* go to Starbucks, where they at least taste decent.

In closing, if you're looking for a distinctive coffee shop in the downtown lewisburg area, the Wild Bean should be one of your main stops. They provide a wide variety of remarkable coffees and teas. If you're searching for a full meal or a "specialty" coffee drink, I would suggest eating out at the other many restaurants lewisburg has to offer.

resp.text:
Good evening Dustin.  We have received your recent review and are deeply sorry about this.   We are curious as to what time and what date you visited our Charleston location?   We never tell someone who was "in line" that we are closed.  When on a wait, we take the guests name down and give them a quote as to when they will be seated.      Providing any additional information that you may havewill help us fix this issue immediately!  Our current hours of operation are:
Mon-Thurs 11am-9:00pm
Fri-Sat 11am-10pm
Sunday 11am-3pm
Please call Kevin at (304) 343-2739 so we can make this situation correct!  Thank you again!

name: electricdrs com
text: Stopped for lunch, this restaurant has adequate seating for a party of 200! A fully stocked bar, bartender included! Wait staff is prompt and friendly. Dining area's appear clean and stocked with appropriate condiments. I ordered the barbacoa beef quesadillas and coke. The portion was plentiful, the barbacoa was extremely mild but flavorful. The choice of  cheese & flour tortilla complements the beef nicely.  On the side was a small portion of black beans mixed with corn an something else, it tastes like their take on pico "maybe". It was fresh and flavorful, excellent addition to the quesadilla. I requested a side of their salsa "no up charge". The salsa is prepared fresh, mild and packed with the flavor of authentic Mexican salsa! I was mildly impressed ☺. Coke was over iced, definitely ask for light ice. I scored them at 4 stars, solely on the price! My single quesadilla and coke was $13.50 before tip! I rate their price as 20% overvalued. However, I can see why they would need that additional 20%, their location and dining room size is what they are charging for in this instance. This would be a great restaurant to hold banquets, group lunches, celebrations etc. Honestly, Black sheep should market this highlight to bring in additional guests!!! Huge untapped growth potential!!! My opinion is the additional 20% cost is justifiable but unnecessary with further business development. To reiterate, I had a excellent dinning experience and will return in the near future! They do offer local delivery in the downtown area, I forgot to ask about any order minimums!

name: Melissa Jarvis
text:
I always have high hopes for this place and I'm always disappointed.  I thought I'd give it another try.  I ordered a BLT with pinto beans.  There were two very small pieces of bacon on it and a thin piece of tomato.  There was lots and lots of lettuce.  Also, the beans were not cooked through.  They still had a "crunch" to them.  That is to say they were not soft like a properly cooked bean should be.
My son told me I shouldn't order a BLT at a burrito joint, and maybe he's right.  But I say if it's on the menu it should be prepared and served correctly.

text: I love love love Black Sheep. The food is consistent at every location. The menu has items you can’t get anywhere else. I mean, asparagus tacos. Come on now. And it’s been my experience there that the weirder it sounds, the better it tastes. I want to try everything on the menu, but I also want to order all the things I’ve had before because they were so good. You can’t go wrong.

Also, they always have a great beer selection on draft. The Loud is a crowd favorite, as it is one of mine. The atmosphere is also very chill and an easy place to hang with friends. Overall, 10/10. Would recommend.

text: Great food and beer in Charleston, W.Va.! Their habanero hot sauce is delicious, but actually registers pretty hot which I loved. The variety and quality of beers was really good and significantly better than a few years ago when I was last here. I particularly enjoyed their IPA, The Loud, but also dug some of their other darker, boozier options as well.

text: Very nice spot. Staff is very friendly and helpful. The bar area is nice and the elevation change makes it feel larger than it is. Good food and good beer. This is a copy of the one in Huntington, but it's just not the same atmosphere. Just like a Primanti Bros chain, it's nice but not the same as the original.

name: Ivan Herndon
text: Service was decent,  food was great, beer was amazing, and the prices are about what you expect at an upscale gastropub. My biggest complaint was the wait for our food. It was a weeknight and it still took 30-45 minutes for everything to arrive. I will probably go back, but never on a weekend!

name: Christophe Adeigbo
text:
A nice restaurant with good atmosphere and a wide variety of dishes. I enjoy that I could come to this restaurant every night for a week and still order a dish that's unique to Black Sheep. There is also a fairly decent bar and plenty of outdoor seating.

I only have two gripes. The first is that the pours in drinks are sometimes very light. And second, the price for a side of salsa is absurd. I do not know why something like a burrito doesn't come with salsa already, and it's $3 to order a side of salsa?

text: Everything is good there. American Mexican food.

name: Bruce Jones
text: First visit. Very pleased. Memorial Day crowd was noisy . They were very busy but got the job done efficiently and quickly. Food was really good and prices reasonable. Parking building directly above the restaurant was a real plus since it was raining. We will return for sure.

text: Food here is kind of eclectic. Not that great tasting, but creative. Most people really come for the craft beers, though, and the selection is pretty good. But it ranges toward the eccentric, too. You need to go to say you have tried it. They growlers, so you can take home the ones you like.

text: Great tasting food and the in house brews taste great.

text: The food tastes pretty ok but I get sick every single time after. The price is too high. Their beers again taste ok but not great with a high pricetag. My friend ordered cheese dip. The waiter asked if we'd like a refill and he said sure only to find out it's $5 each time. They brought it out in so shallow a bowl it could be a saucer. The staff is very friendly and it is clean looking but I would not eat here again unless a pushy friend forced me.

name: John Marion

text: Walked in to a room full of dirty tables and food all over the floor. Server super slow to the table in mostly empty restaurants. Asked for biscuits and gravy without the friend chicken and was told no substitutions. No effort fro. The server  to make any kind of accommodations or figure something out. Got up and left. Food is just average( have a blacksheep  in Huntington WV) and not sticking around to eat in a filthy room with bel ok w average service

name: Rob O'Connor
text:
Delicious food and beer!

Blacksheep specializes in gourmet burritos and tacos, plus some other tasty fare.

The main reason to come is for the burritos and tacos, however. But don't expect Taco Bell. These are gourmet items, with fillings like Thai shrimp, beets, grilled asparagus, and Korean BBQ.

The beers are also quite nice, and brewed locally in Charleston.

For a specific recommendation, I'd go with a "flock" of tacos, that way you get a nice variety of tastes. And while all are good, I have to call out the grilled asparagus taco specifically.

text: Great food and fabulous service. TaMara is the queen!

name: Bridget Neal

The food never disappoints, try the Brisket taco with this raspberry sauces, to die for...

name: Tommie Butcher
text: Great local beers and food is great to.

name: Ron Edwards
text: A clean, tasteful, and modern restaurant which is essentially a brewpub.  They are colocated and have cooperative operations with the Charleston brewing company.   Atmosphere is pleasant with thoughtful sound absorption, however,  if the tank room is power washing,  it is unpleasant. Their sauces are the stars of the cuisine.  Tacos are tasty but main protein portion is small, about on par with the price. Staff was friendly and service mostly timely.

text: The best tacos I've ever had by far. It has a really different take on traditional Latin American food. The pork taco and the curry burrito are my favorites. Brunch menus is also amazing. Excellent beer selection and fantastic margaritas. Never had to wait on a table for more than 5 minutes

name: Aaron Geething
text:
A West Virginia staple (though born in Huntington), taco/burrito fusion deliciousness.  Food is solid, suggest any steak based item and corn tortillas (but have a fork handy if going corn). Love the sweet potato salad and they have great wings if you aren't trying to get too crazy. Almost always a good place to stop in town, unless everyone has the same idea then it can be a bit slow. Like many of Charleston's restaurants since passage of the Brunch Bill this place shines on Sunday Mornings.

I think it would be 4 for me on food and service but the addition of Bad Shepherd Brewery serving inspired new Micro-brews made opposite my favorite bar stool seals the 5 stars.

Great place for lunch, dinner, or drinks.  I like the atmosphere and the food.  I'm from the northern part of the state and frequent Black Bear Burritos.  Black Sheep has the same type of feel and similar, though maybe more creative, types of food.

Also, the tuna burrito is where it's at!!

text: Had a great first time experience. This restaurant has a fully functional brewery, can make up to 17 different beers. The food was great, some of what I ate was borderline spicy. But that is just me, weakling when it comes to spicy hot food. The menu is very chef oriented. Interesting burrito fusion cuisine.  Had the falafel humus burrito,  excellent. Have large portions, of entrees. Sat at the bar, with tender Oliva. Great gal, graduated from Wesleyan. Her other job is with a nonprofit.  Beside the point I guess. The crowd is eclectic,  everything from college kids to foodies and restaurant people. On a final note, everything was wonderful.  Failed to mention , it can be a little loud.

name: Isaac Liu
text:
The last (and only) time I went there service was dreadful, food was subpar, but I'll try to update this review once I go back which might happen someday.

Update: having gone back a second time a few years later, I can say that service is better and the food is pretty good. The only issue I really have now is with the small portion sizes.

name: Bro Man
text: I’ve tried eating here twice. “No Sunstitutions” just seems pretentious. Food not very good either. Don’t know if I will ever try it again.

name: Duke Ellington
text: OUTSTANDING! I will be visiting & recommending this restaurant often in the future!

name: Brian Malonzo
text: Not bad at all. Read reviews that the food was bland but I didn't find it to be the case. Ordered the bulgogi burrito and the California tuna burrito. The tuna was well portioned but the flavor was hidden under all the stronger flavors. The bulgogi was sparse and the burrito was mainly rice but the flavors we're balanced. A little high priced for the portioned served in my opinion but still interested in trying their offerings like the flock of tacos.

name: Clark Zealand
text:
Incredible place with an amazingly creative menu. We walked to the restaurant from the hotel and it was easy to find using Google maps for navigation. We arrived for an early dinner and, even though there weren’t many customers at this early time, there was still plenty of staff around and hence, we were seated immediately. There are many seating options, including: booths, tables, high bar chairs/tables, bar stools, as well as outdoor seating. Our server was extremely friendly and attentive to our needs. The menu has, in my opinion, the most creative ideas for burritos and tacos I’ve ever seen. The wide variety and selection of burritos and tacos made it hard to decide. We tried a few different items as a way to test and none were disappointing. In the end, I went with the following tacos:
Bulgogi: Korean BBQ marinated Flank Steak, Kimchi, Smoked Cashews, & Cilantro
Brisket: Smoked & Molasses glazed, Mt. Mustard, Macerated Raspberry, Fried Shallot
Thai Shrimp: Tempura fried Shrimp, Thai Hoisin-Peanut Sauce, Carrot-Daikon Relish, Cilantro
While eating there, the restaurant got busier and busier and I can easily see how this restaurant is an extremely popular choice in town. I highly recommend this place. Good location, friendly staff, and amazing food!

text:
A staple of Huntington, Jim's has been around for generations to enjoy. The food leaves nothing to complain about, delicious and healthy portions.
Stepping into the restaurant is almost like going back in time to a classic diner down to the modest small drinking glasses but don't worry the staff will make sure the glass never runs dry.
Not only was my waitress extremely helpful but any staff walking by made sure to check on us. Everyone's a genuine friendly face.
If available you can dine at the same table that JFK, John Kerry, and Bill Clinton ate at.
The foods priced fair but be advised they don't accept plastic so bring cash or you can use the ATM by the front door.

name: Loki Bell
text:
Local hotpot owned by generations of the Tweel family since 1938. Family-friendly restaurant famous for spaghetti, pie, fish, and tartar sauce, with large booths for groups or bar seating for individuals. Multiple pictures of celebrities - including Muhammad Ali, John F. Kennedy, and Billy Joel - decorate the walls above the booths they visited.

Jim's Steak & Spaghetti is a fixture in local downtown. With a fixed menu and unchanging prices, it's a favourite of all ages: retirees wanting a throwback to 1960s diners, families looking for a cheap but healthy dinner out, and local university students craving a home-cooked meal. Students get a free slice of pie with dinner if they show their college ID. During Strawberry Pie Week every summer, locals line up around the block; in 2018 over 10,000 slices were sold in 5 days.

***Make sure to bring cash or your checkbook***. To keep prices low, they only accept payment in cash or check -- no cards means they don't lose money to card surcharge fees, lowering costs for customers. They do have an ATM near the entrance in case you forget to withdraw cash before arriving. :)

Every June 9 is officially "Jim's Steak and Spaghetti House Day" in the City of Huntington, first designated by the Mayor of Huntington on June 9, 2013, the 75th anniversary of the restaurant's opening. Jim's was also featured on the July 14, 2015 episode "Two Men and a Wild River" of the Food Network TV show "Southern Fried Road Trip".

We were not offered the tea or coffee which is supposed to come with each meal and is included in the price, and received no discount for not getting them. $19.90 cents later (plus a hesitant tip), we left hungry and had to eat a snack when we got home. As life long residents of Huntington, both of our first trips to Jim's Spaghetti, and definitely our last.

We sat down but when I got up to use the restroom, I stopped by the host to let him know we didn't intend on clogging their reservations, we just finished our day early. He continued to let me know that I should have called and I shouldn't have clogged up their schedule. Again, I explained that it was last minute that our timeline changed. He insisted we shouldn't have done that and we were free to leave. So we did. That was the worst experience I have ever had at a restaurant and didn't even have a bite to eat.

resp.text:
Love these people who have to review every moment of their life, and then leave out the most important details when they are clearly in the wrong. She conveniently didn't say that instead of calling the restaurant to change the reservation when their plans changed, they made another reservation under another name, and then waited to cancel the 7:30 reservation until they walked in the door at 6:15. It is tough to have a 40 seat restaurant and try to fill seats when people make 2 reservations for the same party, especially for the busy 7:30 time frame.

Like I said I like staying here only wish the balcony was open. Thank you to all the staff at Pullman Plaza,  we will see you this weekend for Poison and Tesla Concert 😁 .

10/23/2018  Came here again for Jake Owen & David Murphy concert ... So.. Alot has changed since my last review, as other people have stated my stay was horrible, Construction work all day, loud, dusty, only 3 floors were being used and they were half renovated and half not! Only one elevator was working and it needs some major work done to it, it took forever to get to the 9th floor. The price per night has definitely went up🤑 you have to call in advance to request a mini fridge I knew that from all my previous stays which doesn't really get cold, it was so loud checking in communication was stressful, as if that wasn't enough when we got back from concert 3 rooms all beside us were partying half the night, loud doors slamming, then we got a knock at our door the night attendant ask us if we were smoking in the room?? Really?? So we told him to come in, so he knew it wasn't us, he did and confirmed it wasn't our room it was next door, after waking up several other people for noise and smoke complaints, I was so stressed  and tired. So next ... was checking out again it was so loud from construction front desk charged the wrong room, didn't catch it until in the car, went back in to straighten it out only to hear a older woman and her disabled son complaining about all the noise all night and also being woke up to check for smoke! Hmmm.... finally I told front desk she gave me someone else's room and information and she had to go in and change it all. Next day got a phone call from housekeeping telling us we were being charged a $250 smoking fee, I couldn't believe it! I explained everything that happened that night and she said I would have to talk to the GM Stella, after calling 3 days in a row with no return call from her or anyone we could talk to, we tried disputing the charge at our bank, which didn't work. So trying to continue to get Stella to return our many unanswered calls, emails I told my friend who happens to be a lawyer, and he sent a email on our behalf I wouldn't have cared so much if someone had smoked in the room to pay the fee but noone had, she finally called and told us that she was told by a housekeeper the window was open and ashes were everywhere ( maybe the wrong room ) She removed the fee! I felt like I wanted a refund for the room stay as well because it was miserable stay.  I will never stay there again, even though I have stayed there many times before, I also will be cancelling my reservations for my future stay coming up. It's  definitely not worth $180+ parking. There is a holiday Inn right next door, and 3 or 4 not far away that have many amenities, with a ice machine on every floor not 9 floors down in the kitchen of the bar!!! 😡 Sorry so long, just felt the need to share.

name: Kirsten Cyrus
text: The first time we went about two weeks ago was absolutely fantastic; we had Cheylan the first time and she made the experience much easier, less frustrating, and extremely fun!! Now for tonight, the room was terrible due to delayed reactions, having to "gently " beat on one of the boxes for it to open, and a speaker you can hardly hear or understand, and the game master was pretty rude. Katie was not very eager to help nor very good with hints. At one point we had to ask three or four times for a hint which slowed us down a good deal.   Also, she was a little snappy when we had taken some tape off the ceiling because we saw blacklight paint connecting to each piece of tape so thought it was a clue, we took the tape off revealing numbers, but we now assume those are from a previous game so ignore that portion of the blacklight. But overall, it's super fun to experience the rooms, but End of the Line, the room needs a good update.

resp.text:
Hi Kirsten,

Thank you for the review for both of the games. We take pride in every game and experience we offer due to the extremely hard work we put into our games and how much we want people to have fun. We are unaware of any issues with any of the props and gadgets you mentioned and also communication in the rooms but will look into it immediately.  We will speak with our GameMasters about the game and get their point of view and also will review the game via our recorded video to analyze the experience. Our game masters are part of the game that try to enhance the experience and do a very good job. We will look into this and feel free to contact us directly with any questions or concerns.

We do hope you’ll return for another experience in the future.

Sincerely,
The Lost Escape Room

name: Kevin
text:
Words can't describe how much i love escape rooms. I played these on the computer all the time when i was kid, and when i finally learned that they started to become a real thing in person, I just had to do one. This wasn't my first, and definitely won't be my last.

For those of you who have no idea what these are, here's a short description from Wikipedia:

"An escape room is a physical adventure game in which players solve a series of puzzles using clues, hints and strategy to complete the objectives at hand. Players are given a set time limit to unveil the secret plot which is hidden within the rooms. Escape rooms are inspired by "escape-the-room"–style video games. Games are set in a variety of fictional locations, such as prison cells, dungeons and space stations, and are popular as team building exercises."

That small paragraph literally sums it up. Each room has a backstory. You generally have an hour to escape. You are put in a room and begin your search for clues. Clues lead to other clues, and (hopefully) you solve the mystery and *escape* the room.

The staff here are absolutely wonderful and accommodating.

This place is highly recommended.

text:
UPDATE: Updating my review to four stars for several reasons. First, the quantity of toppings they give you for the price is really generous. Second, the wraps and salads really do make this place a good option for a quick bite. I found a few menu items that are good, but it’s best to just custom build your own because the price is the same. Service is also really good/friendly.

OLD REVIEW: This place has room for improvement which is better than being bad. I ordered the Italian sandwich. The bread was very low quality, and pretty tasteless/bland which somewhat ruined the sandwich. The toppings were extremely fresh and good. But I would rank them pretty far behind some other sandwich options in the immediate area. Someone else in my party ordered a steak pizza, and similar problem. Decent quality toppings, but cucumbers and steak? They need to rework the flavors they consider in their different items. It looked to me like wraps and salads are the items to order here. I don’t think the one-size-fits-all approach (salad, sandwich, pizza) works all that well. I’ll probably give them another shot and update my review as they figure out the kinks. Like most places not everything on the menu can be stellar.

name: Kent Shaw
text:
It was so difficult, before Moxxee opened, to figure out which was the best coffee in Charleston. I'm not a Charleston resident, so I didn't necessarily have that much at stake in the difficulty. However, I work in the city. Suffice it to say, the choices that I saw made Starbucks a reasonable alternative, if it could be accessed.

Then Moxxee opened, and it's all solved. To my mind, Moxxee stands beside almost any other coffee place that I might visit. I'm personally a fan of the piston brewing they have, with individual varietals available. Don't get uptight, but you're only going to get one size (the equivalent of a small).

But it doesn't matter. The way caffeine is served at Moxxee feels like a laser scalpel into the best, most alert part of your brain. I can't emphasize this enough. The coffee is neurosurgeon type precise in how it gets into your brain.

text: Moxxee is the best. Their chai, cold teas, espresso are all great. I haven't tried their blended drinks, but they're popular so I'm sure they're good. I go there to work all the time because they have free WiFi and a really nice staff. It's a good place to meet up with friends, and I've had hours-long meetings in their outside chairs with no problems. It's a really nice place and the service is great, so I feel like everybody should try it. I used to be a barista and I can confirm that they're very clean and conscientious about their practices, and my latte foam is always thick and good. They're neck-and-neck with Taylor Books for title of best coffee in Charleston, but Moxxee wins for me because their parking situation is way better and their WiFi is more reliable.

name: Darrell Dean
text:
Barboursville Park has so much to offer! Anyone of any age group will find the park large enough for any family, social, church, or sport activity. Lake William boasts a beautiful scenery picturesque of a Terry Redlin painting. The walking trails are massive and Lake William offers avid fisherman many places to cast their lines. Lake William is regularly stocked with diverse species of Fish from the hatchery in Pocohontas Co.

There are plenty of playgrounds and picnic shelters for all to enjoy! There are many benches along the walking trail that are covered and swings for couples to sit and take in the beautiful landscape.

People are encouraged to bring their companion animals and the park has numerous animal waste receptacles so you can dispose of your dogs waste.

Highly recommend this park for any family function. 5/5 Stars for cleanliness and care taking of one of the best parks in Southern WV.

The bread for my sandwich was super soft on the inside and had a nice cruch on the outside, the meatballs were moist and juicy which is hard to come by in most meatball subs/sandwiches I've had, plus the various veggies that come with the banh mi were a nice addition to the flavor of the meatballs! Was recommended to try the beef lemon grass banh mi next time I stop by and I still need to try the pho so I'll have to make a point of stopping in a few more times.

name: TheOneSandman
text:
We stopped in here for lunch. It was really good. We both had pho. I had beef and my wife had chicken. It was a little different tasting than my usual Vietnamese restaurant in Charleston, but it was still really good. The spring rolls were pretty good as well. The peanut dipping sauce that came with them was not my favorite version, but it was sufficient.

They staff was friendly and the food came out pretty quickly. It was piping hot. The place seemed pretty clean and kept up. I would definitely go back and would recommend stopping in if you like Vietnamese food or want to try something new and different.

The best thing about pho is that it is very healthy and you don't feel lethargic even after eating a big meal. Granted, I have not tried a comprehensive sampling of the menu, but from what I have tried it was worth the expense. You can expect to pay a little more than perhaps what fast food might cost you depending on your eating habits, but it wasn't expensive by any means. I am happy to pay a little more for good food that is most likely a healthier choice than most alternatives.

One strange thing I noticed was that there is another Vietnamese restaurant right across the street. I have no idea how that happened. Pho U & Mi opened an hour earlier than the other place though, so they got my business that day for that reason. I'm glad we decided to stop by.

resp.text: Thank you for taking the time to share your review! Sounds like everything hit the spot which is great to hear. We'd love to serve you again sometime soon! -Alex P., Owner

text: The food was decent. It wasn't anything special, just run of the mill Mexican food. They had several interesting options on the menu, though. I couldn't even tell you who my waiter was, because 4 different people came to our table bringing various things/asking if we needed anything else. The man who I THINK was our waiter was not accommodating at all, spoke very fast and low, not due to poor English (hearing him talk to other people, he spoke english very fluently) but more due to impatience/wanting to be elsewhere it seemed. I ordered my drink, my friend was still looking at the drink menu, and the next time someone came to our table was 25 mins later, where we were finally able to get her a drink. We got our food, which like I said, was decent at best. After finishing, it took nearly 40 mins for anyone to notice us, and we told our "waiter" we would like a piece of tres leches cake. For the next 30 mins, we sat and waited, for either a server or a piece of cake, when finally someone came and asked if we had been waiting for something. I asked if the cake was already made or if it was being made, he said it was made, and I told him we had been waiting for the tres leches for 30 mins, odd considering it was already made. We were then brought a piece of cake by a different person, only for it to be the wrong cake. When we finally got our tres leches cakeagain, by ANOTHER different person, it was dense, and hardly moist. Definitely wasn't worth the wait. Finally we were able to get out of there, with a bill of $39. Will definitely not be returning.

name: David Walker
text: I’ve been past this place more than a few times. On Saturday 11/23/2019 I finally decided to see what the fuss was about. Arrived around 9:30am and took some time strolling around the exterior checking out the historical signage and sculptures. Once inside I was well impressed. The wide variety of arts, crafts, souvenirs, and food items for sale are of very good to outstanding quality and workmanship. And the numerous shelving displays, hanging pieces, galleries, nooks and crannies, and free-standing art go beyond what the eye can see in this wonderful circular building. There’s a decent sized cafe and a small coffee stand, and just outside a delightful interior courtyard, but it was too chilly to eat out there. Overall this place is most highly recommend and a must-see even if just to browse. But do buy something. There is so much to choose from, and everyone will find something they like.

name: Genny Zbach
text: Tamarack is a premier artist facility in Beckley, WV. It features the best of West Virginia's juried art, music, theater and food. There are several studios, including a glass studio, where you can watch the artists at work. The Greenbriar runs the restuarant which serves breakfast, lunch and dinner. There is a nice theater where concerts and other events take place. A gallery exhibits juried shows of fine art, sculpture and even furniture. A conference center and ballroom add to the possibilities. Walking around the innovative circular building is like being in a museum of incredible and inspiring hand made art. There are items from a few dollars to thousands of dollars! Whether you are an artist or want to buy art, Tamarack is a destination. Tamarack is a place to experience and be inspired.

I got the ham and it was dry, and the pumpkin pie was ice cold.  There was no formal dining room to eat, and we sat at a small table in front of the dining area. name: Chad Kennedy
text: Love visiting here. They have plenty of arts and crafts made by West Virginians from all over the state. They have furniture, Pictures ,way nots, pottery, glad vases, pictures, animals stuffed, lights, knick knacks, snacks, and they also serve some of the best food West Virginia has to offer. They have seating for people eating. They have conference rooms. They also have glass blowing you can watch all day long. They have different shows set up all the time were you can attend and join in on the festivities. They have all sorts of hand made crafts that is all available top be bought. They have Christian group on the weekend were you can attend services. This is a must see when you come through West Virginia. It's also a must see if you live in the state and want to see the culture and the crafts that the fine people of West Virginia have to offer. I've been there a bunch of times myself and I will c continue to go visit this historic place. It's very fun for the kids so bring them along and let them enjoy what West Virginia has to offer. While your there please try the fine dining that this place has to offer. It's some of the best food in West Virginia. Plenty of decorations to choose from and if you'll just take the time to stop you'll see that this place is a very special one of a kind experience for all people of all ages. I personally will be going back for the rest of my life and taking the family with me so we all can enjoy the best West Virginia has to offer.

name: Kenneth Tangerois3 Maroc
text:
Pies & Pints is a popular restaurant in downtown Charleston on Capitol Street. It always has amazing food, especially its pizzas, salads and sandwiches. A variety of ice cold beers and delicious desserts are also available.

Because it is reliably good, Pies & Pints is nearly always full. Credit cards are accepted and it has strong WiFi. The place is next door to Taylor Books.

My only complaint is the loud background music/noise, but if you sit in the back it is more bearable.

My small Caesar Salad was generous and delicious. I was delighted that this restaurant has anchovies, which I happen to love. The chopped (larger leaves would have been better) Romaine lettuce was fresh and crispy, but I should have requested extra Caesar dressing.

Our waitress was efficient and polite, and I was happy to have had such a good meal while visiting Charleston. (I live in Morocco.)

The manager, cooks and kitchen staff are all to be commended. Pies & Pints is a very good place to eat.

resp.text: Thanks for the awesome review!

text: This Casino is amazing. Always pretty. Always fun. Drinks are a little pricey. But, eh it's Okay.

text: So much for smoke free. And it's the stinking cigar smokers..Even the bathrooms with big sign saying no smoking in the bathrooms where full of smoke

name: Rosalinda Flores Uy B. Bell
text: I don't stay at the hotel, coz I live closed by, but the things that gets me, I spend $ ,but never let me win, the Casino have me $120 a month free slot play but never win, that's the reason why I just go three days instead of every day.. I rather go to a joint coz I won,..

name: Judith Hall
text: Nice evening. They are doing a great job of making the place safe.

name: Oscar Romero
text: Careful going in. There is no more smoking on the floor or tables. You can only smoke at the slot machines. You also have to wear a mask everywhere.

name: Dychelle Finley
text: I go because its a very nice casino.

name: Teresa Beck
text: Machines are tight. No Bonus or even small winnings. Didn't hear anyone winning around me either. People I spoke to said same thing Time to go back to Maryland Live in Arundel Mills Mall, Cumberland, and Baltimore.

name: Jessica Barnette
text: Great for a date night.

name: Carl Everly
text: This was the nicest casino we ever have been to. We got treated amazing. We played the slots and won most our money back the whole time. I highly recommend anyone to go there. I'd choose to go there before going to rocky gap or lady luck. This casino is actually the best ever

name: Paul Withun
text: Love the event center, Drafthouse and Prime Cut, but the smoke is just too much... even in the restaurant.

name: James J Space cat
text: The Horses Race's If you are traveling through This place is a definitly must Th Race Track event's are very fun and casual very laid back community of Horce enthusiast and better alike

name: cool 1
text: This casino is open 24/7 - never closes, and as soon as you enter you'll have no idea what time it is, but that's not necessarily a bad thing.  The multiple options of live, or similacast horse racing, table games, restaurants, bars and buffets will leave you satisfied.  The soda is free as well as the parking.

name: Eva Clancy
text: Fun place.  The staff is absolutely amazing!  So friendly and helpful!  Definitely a must visit when in the area.  Try the buffet... quite good for the price...

name: brian bengies
text: The whole family had a great time here... they loved how close you can get to the track.. night racing is the best here

name: Chastity Millikin
text: Had a lot of fun, super nice place, good drink options,  super great staff and service!

name: Raymond Kwek
text: Nice Casino. Has smoking sections, a food court, and plenty of restrooms. They could use more cash dispensing / ticket cash-in machines. At peak times, you typically wait in line. Parking in close proximity to machines, and staff is helpful generally,

name: Brad Karns
text: Dis like. Tired of Losing - do big jack pots ever get hit? every day? It should. Im talking 20,000 or more. Never won more than 3,500. Anybody ever look at there win / loss ration by $ amount. Has anybody ever been in positive and if so, how do you do it? This reference playing mostly slots.

name: Steve Pace
text: Nice line up of entertainment, wide variety of food for every price range and good mix of table games and slots. Add in horse racing and sports book and you can have yourself quit a night in Wild and Wonderful West Virginia! Helps to win a few bucks too! 🤗🤗🤗🤗

name: Jeff See
text:
The actual casino, track, parlors, stage and serving bars are all excellent.

Eat before you go, however, as every restaurant and food services kiosk is barely better than eating at a gas station.

name: JoshuaAdam Brewer
text: First time slot to take in.

name: Mike
text: Cool place! Games for everyone. Several restaurants. Im not a big gambler but i love to people watch... i play the slots occasionally.

name: Maieee WR
text: This Cracker Barrel is up to its highest standards. The store is well stocked and kept neat and easy to walk around.  Friendly, professional staff everywhere with greetings and smiles. The food was prepared to perfection as is the standard in all Cracker Barrels. There were new menu items for spring. The changes/additions keeps my visits interesting. I love seeing what's new on the menu when I visit.

name: Andre
text: Nice casino

name: John Dillon
text: I like this location it has a very large selection of tables and slots.  It has a large area for sports betting and numerous TVs to watch the games.  The Race track is kept in excellent condition and there are spectacular views from multiple locations.  Food court has only 3 restaurants but a nice bar area with live shows.  The buffet is a fair value but I do not recommend it over the restaurants

name: Michele Vansickle
text: The waitress was a 5 star! The food is just awful! We had the seafood buffet.  We had to pay extra for crab legs.  Nothing was good. Not even the crab legs. The butter tasted like plastic.  The seasoning for the crab legs was a knockoff of old bay.

name: jeremy states
text: Always a good time.  Venture to the sky box lounge for a quick bite.

name: Roxanne Nice
text: SO MUCH FUN! super amazing staff. Everyone is so friendly and helpful. DONT SKIP THE BUFFET!🤤 SO YUMMY!

name: John Paknik III
text: My wife and I had a great experience. Won a lot of cash and food is really good here!!

name: John R Crabtree III
text: They are doing a good job at keeping everything clean.

name: Mateo Berry
text: Why are people still smoking indoors? Other than second hand smoke in most of of the casino, I enjoy coming here. Place seems clean

name: Broderick Hinkle
text: Great time. May the odds be ever in your favor.

name: Sean Crook
text: Slots and horse races is your objective here. Very limited table games and they have to get rid of the smoking, very off-putting. Currently the closest sports book to DC but that will all change next year when the law passes.

name: Billy Watts
text: Great food

name: Kimberly Dollinger
text: I’m not a gambler, so maybe it’s just the nature of casinos, but it’s:  like a maze and you could easily get lost, loud from all the slot machine noise, and dreary/dimly lit. Watching the horse racing outside isn’t bad. I’ve eaten at the buffet. It’s way overpriced and the offerings were mediocre at best. We’ve seen some shows there that were pretty good and those venues within the casino were ok.

name: Andrew Shupp
text: Amazing casino. Always have a great time. Dealers and table workers are amazing. Huge variety of slots as well! Restaurants are beyond phenomenal and even the cafe is modern and fairly priced for a casino!

name: Vencil Webb
text: My wife and I decided to make the 5 hour drive after accepting the realization that our local casino Mardi Gras are simply uninterested in the whole idea of assisting someone like William Hill bring entertainment, jobs, and a couple dollars at the end of the day, and we were the real winners in and out of the Sportsbook and now Hollywood casino is our home casino.

name: Loyda Flipping Houses
text: Was a nice place to hang out. Loved that free drinks were provided and live music was entertaining. Has a food court inside which was a plus.

name: Jean Richardson
text: Haven't been for awhile.   Not many jackpots given.   Losing more money than winning.  I checked my comps and 3 weeks ago when I visited the casino I had approximately $1100 in comps.  Went yesterday and checked my comps and had $592. What happened to all my comps in 3 weeks.  Not pleased with the moving of the machines.   Unable to find machines that I enjoyed playing.   Food at the epic buffet was not as good as usual .  Not as much to pick from.  When we came out of the restaurant we had paid $11.99 for 3 carry outs.  We came out with our food and we did not have the top of one of the containers completely closed because the end of chicken leg was sticking out and whomever this woman was told us we could not bring our container out because if was not closed.  We paid for the food and we brought it out. Casino is nothing like it used to be.

name: William Scott
text: Great place to visit for food, entertainment, and all your gambling needs lol

name: Ralph Ellsworth
text: I work as a Table Games Dealer  at Hollywood Casino. I Love giving away the Money and seeing the guests Enjoying their visit!!!

name: Eddy Byrd
text: Pretty Classy local casino. I've seen several other casinos and it may be smaller than those, but for Charles Town WV it is pretty surprising.

name: Robert Conrad
text: Was there with friends for New Years Eve. Very busy live band lots to do.

name: Scotty Hotty
text: Cool casino though we just play the slots a little. Nice for an evening out.

name: Michelle Taylor-Turner
text: Food is always good, just wish you didn't have to go through the smokey casino to get to the special events!

name: Tim Bongiovanni
text: Still don't like the fact you can't touch the cards

name: Jeannie Dunn-link
text: Had a nice evening didn't win much but at least I got to relax some after a stressful  week. Wont be able to go much since I have to stay with my mother that has dementia

name: Charles Bell
text: Go to the epic buffet when they run a special for lunch or dinner if you happen to get seated in one of the booths very private and the servers have always been very nice food I would have to say is so so but worth it if it's a special

name: Scott MacKinnon
text: We like the food and the entertainment they bring to the panhandle.

name: J T
text: It's comfortable and free drinks smoking is allowed ,most people are friendly.

name: John Burgess
text: A fun way to spend the night if you're only going to spend a couple dollars. I'd recommend the horse races to anybody.

name: Sean Epperson
text: This place is so hit or miss. There is the Epic Buffet, which servers rather bland, normal type of generic food at a higher than average price. On the other hand there is a wonder steak house with excellent steak, and you will put a hurt on your credit card to leave. There are table games, and slot machines. name: Big Ludo
text: Great venue for concerts, quality dining options and most importantly the horse races and world class casino including all the regular table games, poker, slots and the only legal sports book outside of Las Vegas, located just outside of the Washington DC metro area, 18 miles from Leesburg, VA and 30 miles from Fairfax, VA. As far as the casino itself and how I'd rate it, to be fair in my rating I have to preface this review by saying that the casino is currently going through alot of change due to the fact that less than 12 months ago the state of West Virginia legalized sports gambling, and the casino has seen a large increase in traffic, I don't believe the casino could have predicted the vast amount of traffic the sports book has brought to the casino. With that being said, I believe the management is doing a great job on the floor considering how busy they are, for example, I've seen the line to place a bet reach several hundred people stretching 300 yards behind the counter running across the entire casino floor, anytime there's a major event like the superbowl for example, be prepared to wait 1-3 hours in line if you're placing a wager the day of the event, I strongly recommend placing bets at least 1 to 2 days in advance, and come in during off peak hours, often times the line is non existent late at night or early morning. The biggest issue is long lines, the casino clearly needs to expand their sports book and add a real sports lounge with better accommodations and more cashiers that can take sports bets, currently they have about 12 cashiers at any one time to receive bets, they need at least double that number to properly manage the flow of people during big events, I've waited 2 to 3 hours in line on busy days to place a bet, not only does this hurt the customer (due to the fact that they must have their bets in before the game starts), but it also hurts the casino because many customers simply leave as soon as they realize that they'll be waiting in a 3 hour line to place a $20 bet on an event. With that being said, I believe the casino and its employees are adapting to the change and doing a great job handling the influx of people coming from all over the country to place wagers on sports, for the first year they've done a great job overall. The food court is new and has a world class steak house called Final Cut, very similar to Ruth's Chris Steakhouse, excellent wine selection with prime cuts of beef only found in the best restaurants in the country, be prepared to spend around $100 dollars per person for a full meal and drinks. Another great place is 9 dragons Chinese, one of the few places in eastern WV that you can get real authentic Chinese food, it's the only Chinese I trust to be consistent in the entire area. The food court overall is top notch. Another great attraction is the entertainment Hollywood casino brings to Charles Town, A-list talent like Jay Leno, Big and Rich, and many other top tier entertainers come to the Hollywood casino to perform, you can expect at least one headline show every month at Hollywood casino racetrack and resort. Charles Town, WV is on the way up in general, located 60 miles outside of Washington, DC, far enough away to avoid the rat race atmosphere and traffic of the DC metro area, combined with the fact that property value is still affordable compared to the DC metro area and still close enough to commute to DC/MD/VA, for these reasons Jefferson County WV is one of the fastest growing areas in the country, much of the credit goes to the Racetrack and the casino, it has provided a great source of stable employment for the citizens of Jefferson county and a positive influence on our entire community in general, a portion of the revenue generated from Hollywood casino goes to our schools and community. Overall, Charles Town, WV is a great destination for families looking to get away from the stress, traffic and cost of living that comes with living in the DC metro area. The Casino has been a big part of why Jefferson county is on the rise.

Very good selection of things but I do feel they are a little high. Remembered a guy selling corn out of the back of his truck in Inwood so went looking for him. Got three dozen of very good corn and saved three bucks per dozen. He was worth going back to look for. Update. I guess  I shouldn't have said they were a little high. With this virus thing ALL food has gone up. Sorry.

resp.text: Thanks for stopping by! Corn season isn't over yet, but next patch is coming into season still.

They also offer hayrides in in autumn.  There is an emu and alpacas on the property. This is a nice place to bring your family, there is something for everybody.

name: Cameron Kirk
text: People always said to go there. Now I truly know why. Huge store lots of awesome stuff. I'll take the drive to go back for sure.

name: James blake
text: A great place to get all your gear. Fun place for the kids. Also sales staff is very friendly particularly a gentleman named Issac Knight.

name: Casie Moore
text: I feel like cabelas is a little sexist when is comes to women's work clothes and shoes. They have so many different steel/composite toed shoes for men but the smallest size is an 8 so as a woman I can't even wear a guy's pair because they are entirely to big. In the women's section they ONLY have a few pairs of steel/composite toed boots to choose from. Come on cabelas... help us women out please!

name: bill white
text: Guns..ammo..guns..fishing..sporting..guns..ammo..sportsman's paradise! Check out the whitetail room and see some of WV's and the worlds biggest bucks harvested. Awesome taxidermist work on display throughout the store.

name: Regi
text:
Went there to buy a new pair of hiking boots, I'd purchased my previous ones there and I was very pleased.
Found a pair I liked, didn't see my size so I asked a sales associate if she could assist me.
She took the display shoe from me, and with a loud huff put it back on the shelf and walked away. Not a word spoken, just a huff and off she went.
I won't be back.

name: James Summers
text: Love Cabela's great place to shop for all of your hunting and fishing needs. Took the girls they had a blast I never give 5 🌟's you deserve it thanks

name: Andrew Smith
text: I've had good and bad experiences here. If you visit the gun library, for the best experience, avoid the older gentlemen named Bill. Most in that department are helpful, professional, and know their stuff.  The last purchase I made there,  Bill was on duty and he was extremely rude to both me and my father. He seems aloof, unmotivated, lacked knowledge of the firearm, and seemed to be very unhappy with his job. Work with Brian or one of the other sales associates and you'll enjoy the transaction. Good luck!

name: Willy Buckle
text: Great and friendly people. All the gear, clothes, toys, etc that you could ever hope for. They even have a great quality selection of firearms at this time, but no ammunition to go with them.

name: Dottie M
text: I went and bought a gun safe. The guy that help us out was very nice and informed us about the warranty

name: Brandon Hayes
text: A great store to shop for almost everything. Always some good deals going on. There is a clearance section which has amazing deals on almost anything. The staff is wonderful and helpful in anything that is needed.

name: Timothy Glenn
text: Very friendly service. Staff went out of the way to address my concerns and educate me on optical gear.

name: Andrew Gringle
text: Great store. Love the items. Prices are high.

text: Most amazing store, everything at your fingertips for the outdoors. Expensive but worth it. Fun day trip there

text: Nice customer service. Was greeted at the front door. Nice big store with a lot of choices of outdoor clothing & accessories. Camping items. Fishing supplies. A lot of hunting equipment & guns. All kinds of animals on display. Nice aquarium of fishs.

name: Benjamin Wheeler
text: Still a man's store. One stop shopping for man stuff. No matter your outdoor pursuits, Cabelas has you covered.

name: Ashley Murray

text: If you need camping gear, winter gear, hunting gear, handguns, rifles, shotguns, etc. this is the place to go. Largest selection of airguns I've ever seen. Pretty much a one stop shop. They also have a huge number of stuffed animal displays that range from interesting to a bit creepy (lots of dead animals), not sure I've seen this many outside of the Field Museum in Chicago. They also have a restraint where yiu can get bison and elk burgers, no idea how good the food is.

I make an attempt to stop in anytime I'm near one of there few locations. I'd also like to mention Cabela's is a family friendly destination!

I want to jump in the aquarium and see if anyone notices. 😜  The best animal displays  outside of the Natural History Museum. So maybe if we can catch the fish and take them upstairs to cook, that would be a delicious idea. How bout it Cabelas? The little guy is hungry!

text: The people were very nice and happy to assist me throughout the store.  The place is clean.  They have a nice selection of firearms.  The fish tanks are awesome.  I didnt give Cabela's 5 stars because I wanted to buy some of their delicious fudge but evidently they no longer make it..probably due to the coronavirus...bummer.  However, I did get a nice reuseable cabelas cup with a straw, a cabelas hat and a multitool knife for appying for a cabelas credit card.  I am trying to patiently wait for it to get here.  My only purchase was 2 foldable chairs in a bag with the American flag on them...$15 each. They also do not have a jewelry dept.  l wanted to look at their black hill gold...also a bummer. It was still a nice trip to the Highlands tho.

name: Karlayna Janiszewski
text: Normally I have very wonderful experiences with coming to Cabela's, but today's was the worst shopping experience I've ever had. I was interested in purchasing pepper spray and a stun gun for self defense. I found the spray on my own and when looking for the stun gun, I couldn't find it. I asked an employee and he said they are usually behind the gun counter. When I approached the man behind the counter and asked about a stun gun, he immediately began bombarding me with questions about my age, and why I would need such things. When he saw the pepper spray container in my hand he began even MORE questions. About where I go to school, where I was working, why I would need anything like that. When I simply responded that I was a pizza delivery driver and needed it for self defense, that was not enough. He asked what pizza place, what location, and would not stop. He began repeating the same questions over and over again very loudly. He followed me around as I was trying to browse the selection. It wasn't until another employee walked over and asked what was going on and this other man actually recommended something for me without any questions as this other rude employee is still loudly repeating questions in my ear, nearly talking over the kind employee. I have filed a formal complaint because this employee borderline harassed me about my intentions and continued with extremely personal questions during my whole time being in the store. I've never had such an awful time.

name: Jeffrey Richards
text: This story is truly amazing. This store offers a wide selection outdoors and sportsman merchandise. Not only is this a store but it's an attraction worth checking out. Just to name a few things, there's a section detailing various deer and also a few sections detailing various animals that can be hunted. The gun library is massive and they also have a spot where you can practice archery.

name: Gary Gilles
text: They were not very friendly, looks like the employee was not happy  with his job. I have been a costumer of Cabela's for probably  25 years give or take and this was only  the second time l left disappointed , sorry  Cabela's. The reason I have been a loyal customer was customer care! Please don't let bass pro take that from you.

text: This is a great place to just get away and forget you have any other thought in your head. This is a huge store in  tridelphia , West Virginia just outside of Wheeling. There are a lot of other stores in the area to go to, but I would recommend that you take a stroll through this store to see the many stuffed /mounted animals they have on display. African, mountain animals, and the large variety of deer . On top of the displays they have something for every family member. Warm weather clothing, cold weather clothing, kayaks, pull behind utility trailers, guns, knives, bows, fishing gear and more. It is unbelievable all the merchandise they have. Easy access from highway. Wheelchair accessible. They even sell food and drinks. It is worth your while to take an afternoon to treat yourself.

name: EJ Johnson
text:
1st visit, had mozzarella sticks and onion rings, both were delicious, mozzarella sticks were the best we've ever had. Also got Bubba burgher and filet hoagie, both again delicious and served as ordered, medium and medium-well. The sweet potato fries were crunchy on the outside, hot and done on the inside. The sweet tea was very good too. We were there on Monday at lunch, it wasn't busy, waitress was very nice. Atmosphere is casual with multiple sports channels playing.
As for comparing them to 5 Guys Burgers,  it's apples to oranges.  Bubba uses steak cuts (NY strip, ribeye, sirloin, brisket)for their burghers and filet for their hoagies and 5 guys uses ground beef. The prices may be a dollar more here but you get what you pay for and Bubba's burghers are juicy, flavorful and thick.
Very much like that it is Veteran owned and operated. Thank you to our Veterans! We will be back.

resp.text: Wow! Thank you for the amazing review!! We are thrilled you loved everything!! Hope to see you again soon! :)

name: Amy Bennett
text: The food and service was as to to be expected from a fast food restaurant. But after me and my 4 yr. old daughter had sat down to eat our lunch, one of the workers walked over and complimented her. She made small talk with her, which I thought "ok, she's just being nice", but after about five minutes it began to feel a little uncomfortable. Finally, a fellow employee came and ask her to run food out to a customer outside. I thought now my daughter could eat finally. Within less than two minutes, the McDonald's employee was right back at our table trying to talk to her. Never once addressing or acknowledging me. I answered a few of her questions she was asking anyhow and instructed my daughter to eat her food, thinking this employee would take the hint and let us eat in peace. Instead, she continued to stand there and just stare at my daughter for what seemed like fifteen minutes. By now she had even made my four year old uncomfortable.  I ask her if they needed her in the back for anything and she andwered "No", without ever taking her eyes off of my daughter. I finally ask her to please go back there anyway so that we could finish eating. Not only did the fact that she stood there staring for so long make it uncomfortable enough, but she was also asking her questions that were a bit too personal for my liking.

name: Don Johnson
text: Nice clean fueling station with a good selection of snacks, drinks and other items one would expect at any convenience store. The only reason I didn't give it a 5 is because of the traffic light at the intersection. Whether going north or south you are probably going to have a long wait (well long for me, so ordinarily I don't get fuel here unless I'm on empty). But, there is a Subway and Dunkin Donuts in the same building, so it is worth a stop for food. If you're heading north you CAN turn right on red to get off US 19 to get to the Exxon, BUT, getting back on 19 you can NOT turn right on red,  so I suggest hanging a left out of the Exxon and go up to Keller Ave (about 500 feet or so at the stone wall), then left again. It dumps you back out on 19 just before the New River Gorge Bridge. Going south, however, you will likely be stopped at the light twice.

text:
Employees are friendly,  they keep up with stock. You can get a wide variety of items in this Little General convenience store, from the local paper to snacks/drinks, beer cold or not, bagged ice,  batteries to some automotive,  cold medicine to souvenirs and gas or diesel. This is a very busy location so expect a line. Don't forget to use your Plenti card to earn points (even on beer, not on tobacco) and Fueland card for 3 cents off a gal of gas plus earn cents off with certain products inside (tobacco included, not beer). There is also a Dunkin Donuts and a Subway at this location for your extra convenience. Easy access from RT19 at the light.

Tip: There is NO TURN on RED (right) at traffic light coming off Court St., the side signal light is for traffic driving on RT19 ONLY.

Decent stay. Bed was comfortable. The staff was AWESOME. Every single employee that I saw spoke to me the entire stay. Don't get that much in hotels.
Breakfast was pretty good. They had some healthy options with Greek yogurt, oatmeal and fresh fruit.
We had a problem with the tub draining and they were great with helping us move to a new room.
Pet rooms are ok. All on the lower level. They do allow dogs, cats, birds and fish. Not many hotels are cool with all those animals. It was great for us as we have a dog and cat and we needed space for them while we escaped the hurricane.

name: William Jennings
text: I am a necessary & essential Point Pickup delivery driver during the COVID-19 crisis. It is my main source of income. Earlier today, I sat out in the orange pickup parking spots for 2.5 hours, waiting on 2 orders that I had from the same location. I missed out on 2 sources of income, which were the regular payment from each delivery, as well as a potential tip from the customers. Both this Walmart & the one in Beckley are both notoriously understaffed so badly that it's not even funny. I had an employee tell me today that they're "a little behind" and the people who pick out the groceries do so at their own pace, which is absolute BS. Orders need to filled in a timely manner. It's a professional position and doesn't cater to slow people. Furthermore, they need to have 5 people on the clock at ALL times, who fill dedicated positions of carting groceries out to the drivers' cars & putting them in. I gave it 2 stars instead of 1, because the MacArthur Walmart usually is really fast, but today was inexcusable. I lost out on valuable income due to their incompetency & it might hurt my reputation with Point Pickup.

It seemed like every few aisles there were 10 to 15 different things that were not in stock; and its a small town so I have been back to the Walmart multiple times during the week and the next week to pick up baby supplies for my child etc... And most of the things that were out of stock were still out of stock or new things were out of stock. This being the only Walmart for many miles is a poor reflection of management. name: John Roberts
text: The 3 star rating is as a community convenience store. It has a good selection of convenience store items, with prices equal to other convenience stores. As a truck stop, I would rate it 4 stars. This is not a palatial travel plaza in the vein of Petro or Flying J. What you get here are the necessities and some of the niceties to make life for professional drivers a bit more livable. Hot meals are available, but the quality of the food during my last meal there was far below the quality when the restaurant first opened. The store and fuel desk personnel have always been friendly and helpful. The best feature for drivers is the sizable parking lot. Even in white - out conditions, I have never failed to find available truck parking.

name: Strat Egerie
text:
We went to Outback for an early dinner recently and it started out good with a waitress at our table very quickly and she took our order and brought us some bread and the water we requested.

We had ordered blooming onion petals for an appetizer since we had tried a whole Bloomin Onion last time we were there and it was just a little bit too much. The pedals turned out to be better and we're actually cooked more thoroughly than the Bloomin Onion had been.

It seemed to be taking quite a while to get the steakhouse salads we had ordered we probably been sitting about 30 minutes before they showed up and we had ordered quickly. When the salads arrived the steak which we had ordered medium was cooked medium-well and on the cold side so we brought that to the attention of the waitress and she immediately offered to get it recooked. We asked if it would take long and she assured us it would be quick.

Within a short time the manager Tom brought us two new salads out of the kitchen, the steak in them looked delicious and turned out to be so.

Tom had made sure that these two Steakhouse salads were done correctly and he also arranged for us to have a Chocolate Thunder from Down Under for dessert on the house.

Overall we had a pretty good time and if things have been right the first time they would have got a 5-star rating, I did give them a 4 star rating, and I'm sure we'll give them another chance because we really liked the salads.

If you found my review helpful please click the thumbs up under it.

name: Michael Brust
text:
I think almost everyone has heard of Chick Fil A so nothing groundbreaking here.

However, I want to say that in my opinion, this location has the friendliest and most courteous staff I have ever encountered. You will always be greeted with a smile. The staff is happy to serve you. The food is served hot unless you want it cold. The food is ready and server promptly.

This location is always very clean; even the restrooms. As you eat employees will walk around keeping things neat and clean and also ask if you would like your trash taken away or if you need anything at all. Honestly, every restaurant that serves food would be wise to emulate the Chick Fil A model. The management of this restaurant should be very proud of the staff working here. They are to be commended.

If you are passing through the Charles Town area, please rest assured that choosing Chick Fil A for a meal will be a great decision.
